footer.tagline: Celebrating Vietnamese culture, cuisine, and community in the heart of Montreal.

home.title: Festival Việt Montréal
home.exploreBody1: More than a street food festival, it's a day of Vietnamese culture in the middle of Montréal. Real cooking made on site by vendors from across the community, alongside the music, colours, and traditions that come with it.
home.exploreBody2: Free to walk in. Come for the food, stay for the vibe.
home.traditionTitle: A Taste of Tradition and Community
home.traditionBody1: More than just food, this festival is a tribute to the rich cultural heritage of Vietnam. Each dish tells a story of tradition, family, and craftsmanship passed down through generations. Whether you're discovering these flavors for the first time or reliving childhood memories, this is a place to connect, share, and celebrate together.
home.traditionBody2: Are you ready to taste the adventure?
home.participantsSubtitle: Explore the incredible lineup of food vendors, performers, merchants, and organizations that bring the spirit of Vietnam to life at the festival.
home.vendorsDesc: Indulge in a variety of authentic Vietnamese dishes prepared by talented chefs and passionate vendors. From street-style snacks to hearty meals, get ready for a delicious journey!
home.performersDesc: Enjoy captivating performances that showcase the rich musical and artistic traditions of Vietnam. From live music to traditional dance, experience the cultural heartbeat of the festival.
home.merchantsDesc: Browse through a diverse selection of handcrafted goods, artisanal products, and unique souvenirs that celebrate Vietnamese craftsmanship and heritage.
home.directionsBody: Roméo-Charette Park is located on rue Jean-Talon Street Ouest, in the Côte-des-Neiges neighbourhood.
home.transit1: About a 12-minute walk from Plamondon station on the orange line.
home.transit2: About a 15-minute walk from Côte-des-Neiges station on the blue line.
home.transit3: Bus routes 92 (Jean-Talon), 124 (Victoria), and 165 (Côte-des-Neiges) stop just a block away.
home.partnersSubtitle: We are proud to collaborate with our generous partners, contributors, and sponsors, whose support brings the vibrant flavors and rich traditions of Vietnamese street food to life. Their dedication helps us create an unforgettable celebration of culture, community, and cuisine!
home.contributorsBody1: We express our deep gratitude to all who have generously donated to support our festival and extend a heartfelt thank you to our contributors for their invaluable time and skills.
home.contributorsBody2: We are also grateful to all others who played a part in making this event successful!

performers.title: Performers
performers.subtitle: Celebrate the richness of Vietnamese performing arts with live music, dance, martial arts, and more. This year's lineup showcases both traditional heritage and contemporary Vietnamese culture.
performers.scheduleNote: Times are approximate and subject to change. Check back closer to the event for the final schedule.

foodVendors.title: Food Vendors
foodVendors.subtitle: Explore the diverse flavours of Vietnamese cuisine at our festival. From street food classics to regional specialties, our vendors bring the best of Vietnam to Montreal.
foodVendors.becomeVendorDesc: We welcome food vendors who want to share authentic Vietnamese cuisine with the Montreal community. Applications open several months before the festival. Submit your interest and our team will get back to you with details.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Have a question? Find answers to common inquiries below.

questions.question: When and where is the festival?
questions.answer: The Vietnamese Festival of Montreal takes place annually in the summer. Check our contact page for the latest dates and location details.

questions.question: Is there an admission fee?
questions.answer: General admission is free. Some ticketed events or shows may require a separate ticket purchase.

questions.question: Is the festival family-friendly?
questions.answer: Absolutely! The festival welcomes people of all ages with activities, food, and performances suited for the whole family.

questions.question: Can I volunteer at the festival?
questions.answer: Yes! We welcome volunteers. Please reach out through our contact page to learn about volunteer opportunities.

questions.question: Is parking available on-site?
questions.answer: Parking availability depends on the venue. We recommend using public transit or nearby paid parking lots.

questions.question: Are pets allowed?
questions.answer: For the safety and comfort of all attendees, pets are not permitted at the festival grounds unless they are certified service animals.

questions.question: How can I become a food vendor?
questions.answer: Vendors interested in participating can apply through our Food Vendors page. Applications open several months before the event.

questions.question: What payment methods are accepted at vendor booths?
questions.answer: Payment methods vary by vendor. We encourage vendors to accept both cash and card, but please carry some cash as a backup.

partners.title: Partners
partners.subtitle: This festival would not be possible without the generous support of our sponsors, partners, and dedicated volunteers. We extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who made this celebration possible.
partners.gratitudeText: We also thank the City of Montreal, the Vietnamese community organizations, and every attendee who joins us in celebrating Vietnamese culture and heritage. Your presence makes this festival a success year after year.
